default_output_dir.description: The default directory where results are saved if not specified in CLI.

filter_code.description: Comma-separated list of HTTP status codes to filter.

filter_keywords.description: List of keywords or regex patterns to filter links and responses.

lcc.description: Limit number of Common Crawl collections to search. 0 for all.

lcy.description: Limit Common Crawl collections by year. 0 for no restriction.

limit.description: Default limit for number of responses to save.

timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for response downloads.

retries.description: Number of retries for failed requests.

memory_threshold.description: Memory usage percentage threshold to stop.

wayback_rate_limit_retry.description: Minutes to wait for Wayback Machine rate limit.

urlscan_rate_limit_retry.description: Minutes to wait for URLScan rate limit.
